title: Working Zones Introduction and Seal Ring's Housing
topics: Seal ring housing working zones introduction
Bearing and seal ring assembly with same fitting diameter
rules: Minimum effective dimension 'a' must be used when dimensions don't allow larger dimensioning, with constraint a ≥ 2 mm
For seal ring assembly followed by bearing assembly: zone L must indicate bearing's fitting diameter tolerance and roughness
For bearing assembly followed by seal ring: every zone must indicate fitting tolerance and roughness values
Sharp edges must be rounded or chamfered where indicated with 'rounded edge a/o rounded side' notation
Surface finish symbol 'spigolo arrotondato e/o estremità arrotondata' means sharp edges must be removed
dimensions: a = 1 mm (minimum effective) when dimensions don't allow larger values, constraint a ≥ 2 mm
Zone dimensions include L and Ls for bearing and seal assemblies
tolerances: Radius R based on diameter ød: ≤ 60 → R = 0.4 mm
Radius R based on diameter ød: > 60 ≤ 120 → R = 0.8 mm
Radius R based on diameter ød: > 120 → R = 1.2 mm
Zone L must retain bearing fitting diameter tolerance specifications
Fitting tolerance must be indicated for all zones in bearing-then-seal assembly
surface_finish: Surface finish requirements indicated by roughness symbols in assembly zones
Rounded edges or chamfers required at transitions (spigolo arrotondato)
Surface possibly with 'plunge grinding' machining and without roughness a/o helical rifrings notation
inspection: Verify minimum dimension 'a' meets effective minimum requirement (≥ 2 mm)
Check fitting diameter tolerance compliance in zone L
Verify roughness values in all specified zones
manufacturing_notes: Assembly sequence determines zone specification requirements
For dc = da (bearing and seal same diameter): seal assembly must precede bearing assembly
Zone L specifications must indicate useful length of execution
All zones must specify tolerance and roughness when bearing precedes seal ring
Sharp edges must be removed through rounding or chamfering
Plunge grinding may be used for surface finishing
training_guidance: When modeling housing for seal rings: always create working zone 'a' with minimum 1 mm effective dimension, constrained to ≥ 2 mm
Apply radius R at transitions based on housing bore diameter: 0.4 mm for ≤60 mm, 0.8 mm for 60-120 mm, 1.2 mm for >120 mm
For combined bearing and seal seats with same diameter (dc = da): model seal seat zone first (assembly order), then bearing zone L with full tolerance specification
For bearing-then-seal assembly sequence: specify fitting tolerance and surface finish for all zones independently
Add edge-rounding or chamfer features at all housing transition zones per drawing callouts
Zone L length must accommodate full bearing width plus installation clearance
Validate that housing bore transitions include proper radii to prevent stress concentrations and seal damage
summary: This standard defines working zone geometry and tolerancing for seal ring housings in gearbox assemblies. It specifies minimum effective dimensions (a ≥ 1 mm, constraint a ≥ 2 mm), transition radii based on bore diameter (R = 0.4 to 1.2 mm), and assembly-sequence-dependent tolerance callout requirements. When bearing and seal share the same fitting diameter, the seal must be assembled first, with zone L specifying the bearing's tolerance and roughness.
